evidence.title: Relation Between Levels and Changes in Lending Standards Reported by Banks in the Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey on Bank Lending Practices
evidence.summary: This note uses bank-level answers to the Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey on Bank Lending Practices SLOOS to investigate the relation between levels and changes in lending standards. We provide evidence that banks responses about levels and changes in standards are positively correlated, although this relationship is not clear in summary statistics.
